changes={

    proper='Waliullah' if word == 'waliyullah' else word.title()

p.write_bytes(meta+marker+r.encode()+boundary+source)

item.text:
Audited all 40 Roman verses in [Ali Ali Sultan Ali](/home/ghayur/.local/state/kalam-codex-round2/workspaces/c651748a4d0e4666bd93040f6047dd4e/src/data/lyrics/ali-ali-sultan-ali.md) against the Urdu. Corrected wording mismatches such as `Yani ke` → `Likha hai` and `kataya hai` → `kataaye haiṅ`, along with nasalization, vowel spelling, and izafat. Verified that the Urdu text was preserved byte for byte. Metadata and stanza layout were unchanged.

Retained `koni` and `zabano` for editorial review because their pronunciation is uncertain.
